rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with the provided 3BC grading: expanded blastocyst, loosely grouped ICM, sparse TE, and thinning zona. It is detailed and plausible, though some image-specific details are inferred rather than strictly verifiable from the prompt alone.
Strong integration of age, prior live birth, ovarian reserve, PCOS, BMI, sperm parameters, protocol, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with the TE-C grade appropriately treated as the main limitation. Minor overreach exists in attributing morphology to PCOS-related metabolic dysfunction and quantifying the effect of prior live birth.

Mostly aligned on SET and general prognosis, but some recommendations are weakly supported or not guideline-based, including ERA after failed transfers, PGT-A framing for embryo banking in a 29-year-old, assisted hatching discussion, and speculative LH supplementation/metabolic claims.

Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, and cycle optimization. Some suggestions are more speculative than standard-of-care, preventing a top score.
